scope: Offline independent review only; no network, server, benchmark, or repository mutation.
failure_inventory_before_implementation: Seven reports agree with each other but reference the wrong source or product.
Declared binary/driver/profile digests differ from retained bytes or frozen source.
A passing verdict conceals changed load, invalid counts, high P99, activation, errors, drops, or excessive allocation.
An invalid/missing fixed environment, changed affinity/cgroup membership, incomplete stages or missing resource cuts is ignored.
A test skips, leaks a process session, times out, or overlaps another block.
Preparation age is interpreted as exact first-request age; resource cuts are misrepresented as exact 60-second deltas.
A/A formulas pool percentiles or count shared CPU twice.
A candidate mixed result is mistaken for a complete 20-result gate.
Partial evidence aborts the reader without retaining a bounded invalidity inventory.
planned_offline_checks: Frozen git object profile and jq validator; explicit expected candidate/run identity.
Actual retained executable SHA-256 plus build provenance and command receipts.
Original 12+8 gate validator; separately recomputed mixed numerical verdicts.
Fixed environment companion, stages, timing, affinity, cgroup cuts, scrape receipts, and cleanup.
Independent per-block CPU/request and median-of-three P99; all-pass A/A at 10%/25%.
Pure phase-check self-test includes correct pass, valid red, forged pass, changed queue and impossible counts.
